# PATCH /api/v1/repos/{owner}/{repo}/releases/{id}

Update a release's metadata (tag name, target, title, note, draft/prerelease status)

**Module:** [routers](../modules/routers.md) · **Auth:** bearer (write:repository scope) · **ID:** `ep-244`

## Request

| Param | Location | Type | Required |
|-------|----------|------|----------|
| owner | path | string | True |
| repo | path | string | True |
| id | path | integer (int64) | True |

**Headers:** `Authorization`

**Request Body** (`application/json`) — `api.EditReleaseOption`

| Field | Type | Required | Validation |
|-------|------|----------|------------|
| `tag_name` | string | False | applied only if non-empty |
| `target_commitish` | string | False | applied only if non-empty |
| `name` | string | False | applied only if non-empty; truncated to 255 |
| `body` | string | False | applied only if non-empty |
| `draft` | *bool | False |  |
| `prerelease` | *bool | False |  |

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| `id` | int64 | Release ID |

- **404** — Release not found or is tag-only
- **500** — Database or git error

**Client:** `git.Repository` · **Auth:** none (local filesystem access)

**Resilience:**

## Business Rules

| Rule | Category | Condition |
|------|----------|-----------|
| Tag-only records (IsTag=true) are treated as non-existent releases and return 404 | validation | release.IsTag == true |
| Git tag is only created when release is not a draft (published) | business_logic | !rel.IsDraft |
| Release title is truncated to 255 characters on create and update | validation | Always on insert/update |

### Error Paths

- **Release not found or is tag-only** → ctx.APIErrorNotFound → 404
- **UpdateRelease service error** → ctx.APIErrorInternal → 500
- **Reload or LoadAttributes fails** → ctx.APIErrorInternal → 500
